verdict.rationale: Composio is an agent integration and tool-execution platform, so it could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, for example in its dashboard. The evidence documents no feature where Composio itself generates insights or suggestions from a user's data. Meta-tools, the remote workbench and providers are building blocks for the developer's own agent, not a native insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
